comments.body: Rebased onto `main`. #21 already covers the `Icon#svg` side (raising `IconNotFound` when there's no `<svg>`), so I dropped that commit. What's left is the `Sprite#symbol_from` guard, which #21 doesn't touch: `main` still does `svg_element["viewBox"]` on a `nil` element. The test now reuses #21's `broken-icon` fixture instead of a temp dir. `bundle exec rake`: 102 runs, 0 failures, `standardrb` clean.
